functions.name: mlk_poly_add
functions.role: In-place polynomial addition over coefficient arrays; updates the first operand accumulator `r` by adding corresponding coefficients from `b`.
outputs: No return value; mutates r->coeffs in place
preconditions_or_contracts: `r` and `b` must be memory-no-alias fresh objects per `memory_no_alias(r, sizeof(mlk_poly))` and `memory_no_alias(b, sizeof(mlk_poly))`.
For every coefficient index `k0` in [0, MLKEM_N), `(int32_t) r->coeffs[k0] + b->coeffs[k0] <= INT16_MAX`.
For every coefficient index `k1` in [0, MLKEM_N), `(int32_t) r->coeffs[k1] + b->coeffs[k1] >= INT16_MIN`.
postconditions_or_contracts: For every coefficient index `k` in [0, MLKEM_N), `r->coeffs[k] == old(*r).coeffs[k] + b->coeffs[k]`.
